@: Speech languages: the Transcribe in... menu of a recording, Settings > Speech-to-text language, the voice keywords per language and the language tags on transcript lines (web/js/sttlang.js). Language names come from the system in the app's language.
unsupported: Irish, Quechua, Guarani and Aymara can't be turned into text yet. For those, pick Detect automatically or the closest language.
@unsupported: "Detect automatically" is the auto option's name; keep them the same.
menu.item_sub: Pick the language spoken in this recording
menu.no_picker: This version can't pick a speech language.
menu.head: Transcribe this recording in
menu.auto_sub: Each speech track is checked on its own
queued.settings: Transcription queued in the language from Settings.
queued.auto: Transcription queued. The language is detected automatically.
already.settings: Already queued. It will use the language from Settings.
already.auto: Already queued. It will detect the language automatically.
@lang_option: A language in the list: its own name, then its name in the app's language.
set.list_hint: Each speech track is checked against only these languages, which avoids wrong guesses on short or noisy talk.
model.multi_html: Speech model in use: {model}, the version of {base} that understands many languages.
model.not_cached_size: It is not downloaded yet (about {size}). It downloads the first time it is needed, or now from Settings > Add-ons.
@saved: keys = the names of the changed settings (internal names, not translated).
kw.label: Voice keywords in {language}
kw.hint: A line that contains one of these becomes a voice highlight. Each line is matched with the keywords of its own language plus the English ones.
tag.found_en_title: Found in the English translation of this line
